title: November 3, 2026 - Open Discussion of Proposals Governance Call
headline: Arbitrum's governance call on November 3, 16:00-17:00 UTC, will cover three on-chain AIPs, an off-chain Stylus Activation Contract AIP, and a Security Council emergency action.
summary: The post announces the Arbitrum governance call for November 3, 2026, 16:00 to 17:00 UTC, held on Google Meet. Up to the first 45 minutes cover the agenda and the remainder is Office Hours for OpCo and Entropy. Agenda: on-chain AIPs (the USDG Core Strategic Initiative, the 1,800 ETH transfer to the Arbitrum Developer Guild and ATMC strategies, and the Constitutional AIP updating L1-pricing parameters for Ethereum Glamsterdam); an off-chain Constitutional AIP for a Stylus Activation Contract; and quick updates, namely a Security Council emergency action dated 30/10/2026 and an ATMC ad-hoc update stating no exposure to the Binance incident. No successful off-chain AIPs or notable proposal discussions are listed. The post says proposals with more engagement are prioritized and explains the two-week coverage logic around the proposal lifecycle: one week on the forum, one week temperature check, then two weeks on-chain.
